reference.criterion: Students typically have their own thin, readable tablet computer weighing less than one pound.
reference.rationale: The 2009 school-technology picture does not support typical one-device-per-child ownership, much less the specified tablet weight/form. NCES documents extensive school device provision by 2021–22, but that includes loaned laptops and heavier devices; the complete form/ownership claim remains partial.
